title: What came between Chimor and Neo-Inca State?
question: What came between Chimor and Neo-Inca State?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Chimor (850) to Neo-Inca State (1537): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: political grouping of the Chimú culture that ruled the northern coast of Peru beginning around 850 and ending around 1470
1537–1572 rump state of the Inca Empire
